Weekend hiking checklist

Pack layers, a map, and extra water for the ridge walk.

Keep the pace conversational on the long ridge and stop for water at each saddle so the day stays easy.

Carry a spare pair of socks, a paper map, and a headlamp even when the forecast looks friendly.

Tell someone which trailhead you used and when you plan to be back at the car.
